_note: Fictional company 'Acme Analytics'. Statements and gold labels were written by the project author. Gold lists contain controls a reviewer would accept; they are not exhaustive, so precision is understated.

statements.text: All users must authenticate with a unique user ID and a password of at least 14 characters.
Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote access and for all administrator accounts.
Accounts are locked for 30 minutes after five consecutive failed login attempts.
User access rights are reviewed every quarter by the system owner, and accounts unused for 60 days are disabled.
Employees receive only the access they need to perform their job duties.
User sessions are automatically locked after 10 minutes of inactivity.
Security-relevant events such as logins, privilege changes and failed access attempts are logged on all servers.
Logs are reviewed weekly for suspicious activity and retained for at least 12 months.
Security incidents must be reported to the security team within 24 hours of discovery.
The company maintains an incident response plan that is tested every year.
Critical systems are backed up daily and backup restores are tested every quarter.
Security patches rated critical are installed within 14 days of release.
Vulnerability scans of all internet-facing systems run monthly and findings are tracked until they are fixed.
Sensitive data stored on laptops and servers must be encrypted.
All data sent over public networks must be protected with TLS 1.2 or higher.
All employees complete security awareness training when hired and every year after that.
Changes to production systems need documented approval before they are made.
Servers and workstations are built from approved hardened configuration baselines.
Storage media containing company data is securely wiped or destroyed before disposal.
Visitors must sign in and be escorted in areas where servers are located.
Third-party vendors that handle company data must meet our security requirements and are reviewed every year.
A risk assessment of critical systems is carried out at least once a year.
When employment ends, all system access is removed on the last working day.
Anti-malware software is installed on all endpoints and kept up to date.
A firewall separates the internal network from the internet and only approved traffic is allowed.
No single person can both request and approve a payment or a production code release.
Wireless networks use WPA3 or WPA2-Enterprise encryption, and guest Wi-Fi is kept separate from the corporate network.
New hires are background-checked before they are given access to sensitive systems.
Acme Analytics was founded in 2015 and is proud of its customer relationships.
The office holiday calendar is published every January.
We take the security of customer information very seriously.

scope._note: Illustrative 'must cover' control set for the gap report. Chosen by the author, not an official NIST baseline.
